g.text: pull every repo, then bring this machine's configs up to date.
gitpullall, myupdater and pullrepos all run this, from any directory, against
every step runs even when an earlier one fails, and the exit code is 1 when any did. ctrl+c stops the run.
the steps stream as they run; a status page follows: what pulled, upgraded (
is the read-only twin: it reports what the steps below would change and writes nothing.
a repo it cannot pull is tagged
, left as it is, and counted in a warning
when the pull moves dotfiles, the run starts again from the code it just pulled, so a fix applies on this run
only: upgrade os packages, before the deploy so a config an upgrade clobbers is linked again
on windows winget upgrades only what a winget app list names and chocolatey only what it installed,
neither to a version already there, nor an app
names; each upgrade is one quiet line,
, and the ones that failed are listed in the summary with the reason
a step whose tool is missing offers to install it with
once an os release upgrade is downloaded, steps 7 and 7b wait for its reboot: any package change would undo it
when an upgrade removes the python running this, the run carries on from the next step on the python now installed
offer to clone repos this machine should have but is missing, asking [y/N/q] first
sync every uv project's environment to its lock, so each repo's own linters and formatters are installed
deploy configs from the manifests, for this host and platform
prune config paths a removals file names and no manifest entry still wants
only: offer to uninstall apps an app removals file retired, asking [y/N/q] per app
the app lists win: a package one of them still names is never offered
on windows, also offer the extra copy of an app an app list installs, found by winget, not declared
only: offer the app list entries this machine does not have
asks once per package manager whether to go through them, then about each app: yes, not now, or ignore here
an ignored app is never offered on this machine again, via
every question for every manager comes first, then everything chosen installs in one go
for this machine's package managers, once to ask and once to install
is the same offer with the ignored apps in it, and a yes takes the app out of the ignore file
a choco app already installed by hand or by winget is listed, not offered: choco would install a second copy
on windows, the duplicate check of step 7 then runs again, so a second copy an install made is offered for removal
on windows only: bring autohotkey in line with the repo's v2 scripts
only: list every app the lists name that is still not installed, in the summary
so a package an installer could not find is read at the end, not lost mid-run
the same, with os package updates and an offer of the listed apps this machine lacks (
gitpullall plus the app offer with this machine's ignored apps in it, un-ignoring each yes (
